old_description: REMsafe SLEEP®, one of our family of businesses and a leading provider of sleep apnea solutions, has announced a new business relationship with TCW, a leading warehousing and distribution company. This relationship will provide offer TCW's fleet of 500 drivers with state-of-the-art sleep apnea treatment.
about:
Lincare is headquartered in Rolla, Missouri, and operates as a national provider of in-home respiratory care and durable medical equipment. The company delivers services directly to patients' homes as well as to nursing homes and long-term care facilities across the United States.

The company's core offerings span home oxygen therapy (stationary and portable), sleep apnea treatment with CPAP and bilevel PAP devices, nebulizer therapy for conditions such as COPD and asthma, and home INR testing for warfarin patients. Lincare also provides enteral nutrition support with trained dietitians, high-frequency chest wall oscillation therapy, powered mobility equipment including electric wheelchairs and scooters, pediatric respiratory services, pharmacy delivery, speech-generating devices, tracheostomy and suction management, and both invasive and non-invasive home ventilator care. Digital tools such as the VentCircle™ mobile app and a secure patient portal support supply ordering, usage tracking, and account management.

Lincare serves individuals with chronic respiratory conditions, sleep disorders, and mobility limitations, as well as institutional customers such as long-term care facilities. A noted business relationship includes providing sleep apnea treatment to the 500-driver fleet of warehousing and distribution company TCW through its REMsafe SLEEP® family of businesses. The company also supports Medicare beneficiaries and offers out-of-pocket options for services not covered by insurance.

Lincare states its mission is to set the standard for excellence in home respiratory care, aiming to enable patients with chronic conditions to remain engaged in life. Differentiators highlighted by the company include complimentary programs such as CareCheck™ for COPD early intervention, HeartSteps® for congestive heart failure management, and SleepEaze™ for sleep disorder education and adherence support.
